ai_summary: Here is an executive summary of the financial document:  Akme Fintrade (India) Limited reported a strong H1 FY27, achieving a significant milestone by surpassing Rs. 1,000 crore in Assets Under Management (AUM) with a 35% year-on-year increase, coupled with a nearly 20% growth in Profit After Tax (PAT). The company demonstrated sound financial health, marked by improving asset quality with declining Gross and Net NPAs, and a robust Capital Adequacy Ratio of 44.95% providing ample headroom for continued growth. While the Capital Adequacy Ratio decreased from the prior year, it remains exceptionally high, and no material red flags are immediately apparent given the strong operational performance and asset quality improvements.
